podcast.description: 每天自动更新的 Bloomberg 公开 RSS 中文摘要，适合 iPhone 和 CarPlay 播放。

episodes.title: 每日简报：聚焦重要新闻
episodes.summary: 今日重点关注中国在中东的沉默、特朗普与马斯克等人的困境以及Micron科技公司的业绩。

sources.title: Why China Isn't Speaking Up on the Iran War
sources.description: China has been noticeably quiet about the conflict in the Middle East, even as it engulfs a major Chinese friend, Iran. The silence, though, is deliberate. Rebecca Choong Wilkins explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: Why the Epstein Files Fallout Keeps Growing
sources.description: Business leaders have blamed a range of villains for public anger toward the status quo, but it’s past time they take some responsibility.

sources.title: The Rise And Fall of Peter Attia’s Longevity Empire
sources.description: Attia built his brand on trust and credibility. The revelation of a yearslong relationship with Jeffrey Epstein has upended that.

sources.title: Gabbard Set to Face Scrutiny Over Iran Stance at Threats Hearing
sources.description: A year ago, Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard testified at the Senate’s annual hearing on global threats that Iran wasn’t building a nuclear weapon.

sources.title: Micron Earnings Face High Expectations as Its Stock Keeps Rising
sources.description: Soaring prices for memory chips have made Micron Technology Inc. one of the standout stocks of 2026, and its earnings after the close on Wednesday will give clues on whether the rally is sustainable.

sources.title: Oil Prices Drop as Iraq Signs Pipeline Export Deal
sources.description: Oil dipped as Iraq signed a deal to resume exports via Turkey that avoids the Strait of Hormuz, and as the US stepped up efforts to force the reopening of the key waterway. Iraq agreed with Kurdistan to resume oil exports through a pipeline in the semi-autonomous region that goes to Turkey’s Mediterranean port of Ceyhan. The rerouting of the oil will only partially relieve supply concerns. Bloomberg’s Anthony di Paola reports.

sources.title: UniCredit CEO Says Commerzbank Bid Intended to Break ‘Stalemate’
sources.description: UniCredit SpA Chief Executive Officer Andrea Orcel said his takeover bid for Commerzbank AG is designed to bring about negotiations between the stakeholders as he seeks to breathe fresh life into a deal he’s been pursuing for more than 18 months.

sources.title: Citi Sees BOK Raising Rate Toward 3% This Year on Inflation Risk
sources.description: The Bank of Korea is likely to raise its policy rate to 3% this year as a surge in global oil prices drives inflation higher, according to Citigroup Inc.

digest.episode_title: 每日简报：聚焦重要新闻
digest.episode_summary: 今日重点关注中国在中东的沉默、特朗普与马斯克等人的困境以及Micron科技公司的业绩。
digest.lead: 今天，我们将关注几个关键领域的最新动态。首先，我们讨论了中国对伊朗战争保持沉默的原因。

stories.headline: 为什么中国不谈论伊朗战争
stories.summary: 尽管伊朗是一个重要的盟友，但中国在中东的冲突中显得格外沉默。这种沉默是有意为之。
stories.why_it_matters: 了解这一行为背后的动机对于理解国际政治格局至关重要。

stories.headline: 为什么埃普斯坦文件风波仍在继续
stories.summary: 商业领袖们一直将愤怒归咎于现状，但该是时候他们自己承担一些责任了。
stories.why_it_matters: 这揭示了一个长期存在的问题，并可能引发更广泛的讨论。

stories.headline: 彼得·阿提亚长寿帝国的兴衰
stories.summary: 阿提亚建立品牌的基础是信任和信誉，但最近的揭露使这一切都受到了质疑。
stories.why_it_matters: 这一事件对他的声誉造成了严重影响，并可能影响他未来的发展。

digest.closing: 在今天的简报中，我们探讨了国际政治、商业领袖的责任以及一个长寿品牌的重大挫折。希望这些信息能帮助您更好地理解当前的世界。
digest.audio_script: 今天我们要关注几个重要的新闻点。首先，我们将讨论中国在中东冲突中的沉默行为。接下来是关于埃普斯坦文件风波的进一步发展。最后，我们来看一看彼得·阿提亚长寿帝国的兴衰故事。这些事件对国际政治、商业领袖的责任以及一个长寿品牌产生了深远的影响。希望今天的简报能帮助您更好地理解当前的世界动态。
